answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation follows exponential temporal decay, so EigenTrust-derived centrality remains high only through sustained, reciprocated honest service. A newly spawned sybil begins with negligible inbound trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality; collusive edges cannot bootstrap it because reciprocity-weighted transitivity is bounded by established nodes. Consensus therefore rejects the identity before it can credibly guard a vault, emit a signal, or wield a quill.
